questions.q: What disappeared from Mihailo Jovanović's locked villa?
o: His wife Sofija — only an empty frame was left
questions.e: Sofija vanished from a locked house, leaving an empty frame.
She went into the room to finish her portrait.

questions.q: What did Inspector Marko notice on the floor under the frame?
o: Traces of white pigment used for ultraviolet paints
questions.e: White pigment used for ultraviolet paints.

questions.q: What did Marko see on the “empty” canvas under ultraviolet light?
o: A terrifying portrait of Mihailo made of many screaming faces
questions.e: Under UV light a portrait of Mihailo made of tiny screaming faces appeared.

o: To declare Sofija insane and take her paintings and the insurance
questions.e: He planned to have her declared insane and seize her property.

o: Mihailo was arrested, and Sofija found peace on the Adriatic coast and kept painting
questions.e: Mihailo was arrested; Sofija resumed painting on the Adriatic coast.
